title: Intern Sector Coverage - Transport & Logistics (f/m/x)
full_description:
Frankfurt am Main, Germany
You are interested in planes, cars, ships or trains and want to combine this interest with gaining in-depth knowledge in the banking sector? Join ING’s global hub for Transport & Logistics ("T&L") in Frankfurt! We offer you an excellent opportunity to develop yourself and become acquainted with many aspects of the T&L sector, structured finance solutions and the wholesale banking business.
Together with our team you will service our globally active clients with corporate and structured finance solutions.
You support colleagues and deal teams in their daily commercial activities, like performing live transactions, managing existing client relationships and portfolios, and executing Know-Your-Customer (KYC) processes in close collaboration with relationship managers and the KYC team.
You perform commercial assessment by collecting and analyzing information about customers and the markets in which customers are active and assist in the preparation of credit analyses for our clients, including Excel modelling.
Furthermore, you manage, monitor and promote the quality of the commercial and operational services, take care of the administrative handling of processes and are intensively involved in updating ING systems. All the while you maintain contact with both internal and external stakeholders and make sure that agreements made are correctly implemented.
With keen wit and attentiveness, you anticipate the requirements of the team, take the right action and come up with good ideas.
In short: you make every effort to deliver excellent service and quality to customers and to your contacts within the ING network.
Enrolled in Bachelor‘s / Master‘s degree preferably in Economics, Econometrics, Economics, Finance or Law or in a gap year between Bachelor‘s and Master‘s degree programs
Analytical, detail-oriented team-player who takes responsibilities
Customer-centered and service-oriented mindset
A high degree of self-initiative
Proficient in MS Office products, especially Excel
Willingness to contribute to shaping the world of tomorrow
Exceptional communication skills in English, any other language is a plus
Available for 6 months (please specify the exact period incl. start date in the cover letter)
Look forward to many benefits
Attractive salary, free Deutschlandticket, 30 days’ vacation, company restaurant
Teamwork as equals in a relaxed atmosphere
Hybrid working: In addition to working in the office, you can also work remotely – within operational, regulatory and legal requirements.
Powerful networking opportunities, personal and professional continuing education possibilities, as well as numerous offers for fitness, preventative care, nutrition and work-life balance
Are you up for a new job?
At ING we are colourful and diverse: different personalities with different perspectives - an international culture where we value and appreciate each other. We believe in substance over style, people instead of labels.
Simply apply online –the quickest way is if you already have your cover letter, CV, and certificates at hand.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
